Measures to counter violence in North
Eastern Region
*1. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in just over
two years 35 major incidents of violence
were reported from the North Eastern
Region; and
(b) the measures taken  to counter  the
militant groups operating  in North Eastern
States?
Sexual harassment of women in police
custody
†*2. SHRIMATI  KAMLA MANHAR:
Will  the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been an increase
in the cases of sexual harassment of women
in police custody; and
(b) if so, the State-wise details  in the
above cases and the number of guilty
punished during the last three years?
MIG-21 aircraft crashes
†*3. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of MIG-21 aircrafts that
crashed in the last five years;
(b) the number of pilots and army
officials killed in such air crashes during
the last five years; and
(c) the reasons for the continuous
accidents of MIG-21 aircrafts?
Strategy for Commonwealth
Games 2010
*4. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a sports strategy and
plan in place in view of the coming 2010
Commonwealth Games in New Delhi;

(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Killings of elderly people in Delhi
*5. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:  Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of elderly couples
murdered in Delhi since January, 2004;
(b) the number of killers of these elderly
couples arrested/nabbed; and
(c) the concrete steps Government have
taken for the safety of the elderly people?
Compensation to disabled soldiers
*6. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether, as reported in the media it
is a fact that 40 thousand  soldiers who
were injured  in battlefield  have not got
compensation as given to others;
(b) whether there was any
representation from  such  groups of
soldiers; and
(c) how far Ex-servicemen Contributory
Health Services give help or benefits to
such disabled soldiers?
 Measures to improve  standard of
sports
†*7. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that adequate
measures are not being taken to improve
the standard of sports in the country;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
ever increasing influence of politics and
commercialization in the field of sports,
problems are being faced  to improve the
standard of sports; and
(d) if not, the  reaction of Government
in this regard?
Provision of safe drinking water
*8. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of villages in the country
where Government has not been able
to provide safe drinking water, State-
wise;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
provide safe drinking  water to the people
of these villages;
(c) the total amount provided to each
of the State Government for this purpose;
(d) whether the Central Government
propose to take this task of providing safe
drinking water on war footing with
assistance from private sector;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the  reasons therefor?
Workers killed/injured due to collapse
of portion of T3 tunnel of Tehri Dam
*9. SHRI AMAR SINGH:  Will the
Minister of POWER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  a  large
number of workers have been killed and
injured as a result of collpase of unlined
portion of T3 tunnel of Tehri Dam;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the matter has been probed
by Government and if  so, by whom and
what are its findings?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Training facilities for MES officers and
staff
1. SHRI  KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the  Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the strength
of MES Officers and subordinate staff is
approximately 1.5 lakh;
(b) if so, whether there are any training
facilities for  them;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide proper training institute for them;
and
(e) if so, when the institute is expected
to function?
Sending of Indian Army Commandos
to foreign countries
2.  SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
lend Indian Army's Commandos to other
countries who are on friendly terms with
our country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the manner in which the operational
cost of such commando operations would
be met?
More powers to coast guard
3. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
give more teeth to coast guard so as  to
enable it intercept and inspect all ships
within the country's exclusive economic
zone;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any other country has given
this kind of power to their coast guard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Appointment of more women doctors
in the Army
4. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry propose to
appoint more women doctors in the Army

looking at th e increasing number of
aspirants in the force;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of women doctors in the
Indian Army as on 1st December, 2004?
Benefits to Kargil war widows
5. SHRIMATI  PREMA  CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even after
five years of Kargil operation many war
widows have not got any benefit from
State/Central Government although a lot
of things were announced at that time;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details of war widows who are still to get
the due benefits; and
(c) by when the remaining war widows
will get their dues?
Death of pilots and civilians in MIG
crashes
6. SHRI  DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have compiled
the latest figures of the total number of
Indian Air Force (IAF) pilots killed in MIG
crashes since 1971;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of civilians killed in
these MIG crashes;
(d) the loss in terms of money suffered
by the IAF pilots; and
(e) whether any concrete measures have
been taken to improve the situation and if
so, the details thereof?
Physical tests of women aspirants to
the Army
7. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that unmarried
women candidates between the ages of 21
to 27 are made to undergo physical test,
including gynaecological tests by male
doctors for the past ten years as part of the
recruitment process in the Army; and
(b) the remedial measures proposed to
get this sensitive issue affecting women
resolved?
 State of bridges constructed at
Tanakpur-Tawaghat road
†8. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) when the improvement and
broadening work at the Tanakpur-Tawaghat
motorable road was undertaken and by
when the same is likely to be completed;
(b) whether it is a fact that most of the
bridges constructed thereon have turned
unusable and some of them have been
closed down for traffic; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action being taken against the persons
responsible therefor?
Shifting effect  of Idgah abattoir
on IAF
 9. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Indian Air Force is
against the shifting of Idgah slaughter
house to Ghazipur near the Hindon Air
Base in Ghaziabad;
